summary: NextNRG (NXXT) filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, reporting an Amended and Restated Voting, Support and Standstill Agreement with certain stockholders, effective September 30, 2026. The agreement updates the August 13, 2026 original to reflect the company's reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, changes to the Series C Certificate of Designation, and an extended termination date tied to required stockholder approvals or December 31, 2028. Item 3.03 covers the completed reincorporation. No price, stake, premium, or acquisition terms are stated. This is a routine governance action, not a special situation.
